offer.text: My tannery's run dry. Eight leather would let me get back to my craft.

accept.text: Good hide makes good boots. Off you go.

decline.text: Bare feet for the village, then.

in_progress.text: Have you any leather for me?

ready.text: Eight good hides. The tannery lives again.

complete.text: I'll stitch you something fine one of these days.
